decisions.reason: Drops the unnecessary comma between a compound subject; same meaning, cleaner English.
반백 is half-gray hair, not merely hair that is graying.
Em-dash apposition reads more naturally than a stop and a hanging fragment.
SOL improves 전의 but drops 순식간에 from the path opening.
decisions.replacement: The cheers rekindled their fading will to fight. Lee Cheonbaek surged down the path that had opened in an instant.

decisions.reason: 가만히 지켜보고 있을 … 아니었다 is immediate refusal to stand by, not a character sketch.
Former heyday is redundant; heyday already marks the past 강성했던 시절.
품었다 / 가슴에 is the heart-and-waist paired-sword image, not a blade strapped to the chest.
Both add an intensifier 절정의 무인 does not carry; keep SOL’s syntax without exceptional/highest caliber.
decisions.replacement: Who was Blood Wolf Sword Lee Cheonbaek? A man who had founded the Mount Heng Sword Sect with nothing but a single sword and now sought to become the ruler of an entire city. Enemy or not, there was no denying he was a Peak martial artist.

decisions.reason: 호승심은 접어야 한다 is an obligation to set the urge aside, not a narrator rule that it had no place.
협봉검 is a narrow blade; narrow sword is a weaker collocation.
His answer is more natural, and family’s is redundant before Jin Family of Taiyuan.
His father is more natural than the father while keeping 홀연히 사라진.
서신 is a letter; note also clashes with letter in the next beat.
Had no idea and no comma before or is cleaner spoken narration.
Was now the Family Head is the more natural English placement of 지금은.
Keeps 죽음/생존 and 짊어져야; SOL’s lives and rested flatten both.
부릅떴다 is eyes flared wide, not blazed; SOL’s raised-sword sentence is the better English.
decisions.replacement: Jin Wikyung’s eyes flared wide. He raised his sword, and an Azure Dragon’s Roar burst from his mouth.

decisions.reason: Soared and shot high better match 날아올랐다 and 솟구쳤다 without changing the signal beat.
그것도 그때였다 is simultaneity; rose matches 몸을 일으킨.
Keeps the 소낙비처럼 simile SOL flattens to a generic downpour.
One ambition after another is the more idiomatic 차례차례 실현.
Simple past with then strengthened it is tighter historical narration.
He had not died in a fair duel follows the corpse beat more naturally.
연관된 것들은 죽이고 불태우기로 is kill-and-burn everything connected, not people versus their property.
나타났다 / 눈앞에 is appeared before his eyes, not stood now.
Preserves 눈에서 불길이 쏟아졌다 instead of generic blazing eyes.
His blade filled with is more natural for 머금은 검신.
Armor or divine weapon is natural English for the 도/기도 pair.
SOL drops 확신에 찬 and turns 휘두르려던 into already raising the sword.
A complete came-from-behind sentence matches 들려온 without the fragment.
덜컥 내려앉았다 is a sudden drop, not a slow sink.
Naturalizes the 뒤를 내주다니 beat and 뒤로 찔러 넣었다 as a reverse-grip thrust.
Korean 고 is sequential and, not contrastive but.
입가에 맺힌 is a smile settled at the mouth corners, not playing around the lips.
알아차렸다 is recognized, not merely knew.
그러는 자네는 is then you, not a simple and.
Includes 느꼈다 without adding meaning.
If he took his eyes off is more natural than the imperative-conditional.
Beyond reason and impatience had gotten the better of him are the better idioms.
이미 답은 나와 있었다 is that the answer was already clear, not that only one answer existed.
SOL correctly reads the 초식 gap; BASE keeps 윗줄 as a league above.
decisions.replacement: Whether the difference was a full form or half of one, the old man before him was a master a league above Lee Cheonbaek.

decisions.reason: 뒷방 늙은이 is an old man in the back room, needed for the following callback.
Source asks both why not stay in 뒷방 and why come out; SOL drops the back-room image.
decisions.replacement: “Then why not stay in the back room? What did you come out for?”

decisions.reason: Keeps 젊은 친구 and 움직여 줘야 as get moving, not move around.
Exact opposite preserves 정반대로.
Keeps the 하면 conditional and 한마음으로 as unite as one.
무거운 눈으로 and 입이 열렸다 are a separate beat SOL collapses into asking.
The question stays on its own line once H047 keeps the stare/mouth-opening beat.
Spoken order is more natural while keeping Blade of Flowers at thirty.
나이 서른에 is at thirty, not by the age of thirty.
변화했을까 is how it had changed, not how far it had advanced.
늙었군 is completed aging, not I’m getting old.
모든 것 is everything, not every obstacle.
한 수 위 is a level above, and 달려들어 is charged, not a generic stronger lunge.
Started and begun are indistinguishable.
혈육 is blood relatives, not generic family.
More natural syntax; 집무 as managing the sect fits the Sect Leader beat.
지금처럼 points at the thinking he is doing now.
Elliptical Because… is the natural reply to Why are you laughing?
죽음이 두려웠나 is afraid of death; the two lines are equal.
Tighter second sentence with the same 대봐도 결과는 변함없다 joke.
손에 들린 is the moment it entered his hand, not held it out; 예기 is a killing edge.
먼저 오시게 requires first.
Active drew in … raising is cleaner than the having-drawn-in participle.
Drops 신형 body translationese; Lee Cheonbaek shot forward is the natural English.
독문 무공 he had perfected is specifically his unique art.
Keeps 난도질 as hacked, 사이로, and 순간적으로; SOL adds into the air.
간격에 휘말린 is caught in the gap, not in the crossfire.
젊은이의 목소리들 is young men’s voices, not merely sounded young.
SOL drops 붉은 from the warning signal.
Behind me is the natural English combat thought for 뒤!
보였다 is he saw the white beard, not a floating image.
검도 is And the sword as well; SOL adds Then he saw.
큭 is the shorter grunt; Ghk is already used for 크윽.
정신없이 물러났다 is uncontrolled reeling, not falling back in a daze.
뇌성벽력 is thunder and lightning resounding, not like a thunderbolt.
Keeps 줄줄이 stream and 바람을 찢었다; SOL adds from the blades.
넋이 나간 얼굴 is slack-faced; SOL’s daze drops the face.
In that moment and At that moment are indistinguishable.
Keeps 검기의 향연 as a feast and 보는 것만으로도.
움직임은 … 빠르고, 강했다 is faster and stronger, not struck harder.
신음처럼 is like a groan, not with a groan.
그들의 눈에는 / 누가 이겨도 이상하지 않은 is either outcome would make sense, not either could win.
힘의 우위 is superiority, not a mere difference.
Bit his lip is the natural collocation for 입술을 깨물었다.
훑고 지나간 is raked, not raked open.
Sword hand is the natural rendering of 검을 쥔 손.
하필이면 is of all things, the unlucky fact of the sword arm, not of all places.
재빨리 is quickly, not at once.
SOL turns 모자랄 into victory demanding everything; BASE’s sword-arm phrasing is clumsy.
decisions.replacement: Even at full power he would have been hard-pressed. Now that his sword arm was injured, the outcome was all but decided.

decisions.reason: 손목이 꺾였다 is snapped, not a generic broke.
당해 낼 수 없었다 is stand against the Head Elder; SOL’s the Head Elder’s is a dangling possessive.
숱하게 겪었다 is suffered … countless times.
Arm, waist, and legs is cleaner parallelism for 팔과 허리, 다리.
이번에는 무릎이다 is the terse reveal; SOL adds the strike took.
SOL’s severed is better for 잘려 나간 but drops 스르륵 slowly.
decisions.replacement: With its tendons severed, the knee buckled slowly, with no regard for Lee Cheonbaek’s will.

decisions.reason: Cut through flesh and bone is the more natural English for 자르는.
Pieces of organ is ungrammatical; pieces of his organs matches 내장 조각.
안색은 무덤덤했다 is was impassive, not remained.
Maps 희열 to the felling and 기쁨 to the war ending.
당연한 결과 is the natural result, not the expected result.
In front of me and before me are indistinguishable for 눈앞에.
그릇 is capacity, not greatness.
내 목을 주겠소 is my neck, not my head; make them surrender is 항복시키고, not order.
불가 is Impossible, a formal refusal, not No.
어째서……! is an anguished exclamation, not a question.
본가 from the Head Elder is our family, and the sentence is cleaner.
BASE is redundant; SOL loses 목소리를 쥐어짜 내는.
decisions.replacement: But with wounds this severe, all he could do was wring out a voice.

decisions.reason: Keeps 네놈들이 as you bastards and 어린 녀석 as young boy.
그 아이가 시작이었지 does not include all.
고소 is a sardonic smile, not a bitter one.
Divided Shanxi is the more natural 양분하는.
Keeps 지금까지도 as even now.
Two-clause burrowed … and his eyes flew wide is more natural for 부릅떴다.
Present-scene 이었다 is simple past, not past perfect.
아무것도 모른 채 is knowing nothing, not without ever learning the truth.
Keeps the matching fragment after BASE’s pity line; it was is padding.
저승길 노잣돈일세 is the terse identification; Consider it and your soften it.
Known as is more natural than called for 이천백이라는 거인.
사로잡힌다 is taken prisoner, not merely taken.
그렇게 is like that; SOL drops it.
No comma after begin; the victory-drunk moment is essential, not parenthetical.
파공성 is a sound tearing through the air.
최후를 직감한 is sensing his own end.
Restrictive wrapped in blue Sword Energy needs no pausing commas.
SOL’s syntax and defied are better, but it drops 파공성 as a tearing sound.
decisions.replacement: But both the tearing sound that had come first and the direction of the sword defied Lee Cheonbaek’s expectations.

decisions.reason: SOL invents wheeled around and drops 난데없이.
웬 놈이냐! is an exclamation, not a question.
다음 순간 is the next instant, not an instant later.
얼굴을 확인한 is seeing the face; that recognition beat is why he groans the name.
